_about: Student access codes, one per module. Each cohort has a code, a title shown on the hub, and the sections (by name in tools/hub.json) and single primers (by slug) it opens; a code holder sees only those on the hub. Codes are a convenience to keep students focused, not security. The owner password (SITE_PASSWORD secret) always opens everything. An optional notice (plain text) is shown to code holders on every page; leave it empty for none.
